title: Three separate intelligence sources told Coulthart to watch Dark

tellings.quote: playbook, but they had all said, "Well, if you really want to understand what's going on, watch this Netflix series, Dark."

plain: A researcher named Bryce, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast about Hollywood and UFOs, relays a story about Ross Coulthart, a journalist who reports on UFO secrecy. According to Bryce, three separate intelligence sources told Coulthart within a short time that if he really wanted to understand what was going on, he should watch Dark, a Netflix science fiction series. The point of telling it is the hint that insiders might be steering people toward the ideas in that show.
